# package objectjson

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/objectjson"
```

Package objectjson gives the objects of package openadr the JSON of a revision of OpenADR: the representation a VTN of that revision answers with. It is for a program that shows objects or reads them from files, such as a command-line tool, and has to write them as the VTN it talks to would.

What a revision cannot carry is refused, as by the clients: string targets in 3.0.1, typed targets in 3.1.0. Resource groups are not of either revision (see openadr.ResourceGroup) and are encoded as this module's VTN gives them, with 3.1.0 only.

## Functions

### func Marshal

```go
func Marshal[T Object](v openadr.Version, obj T) ([]byte, error)
```

Marshal returns obj as revision v gives it; the zero Version is 3.1.0. An unknown revision matches openadr.ErrConfiguration, and what v cannot carry is a \*openadr.ValidationError, or errors.ErrUnsupported for a resource group in 3.0.1.

### func Unmarshal

```go
func Unmarshal[T Object](v openadr.Version, data []byte) (T, error)
```

Unmarshal reads an object, or a create or update request for one, as revision v writes it. The result is not validated: call its Validate.

## Types

### type Object

```go
type Object interface {
	openadr.Program | openadr.Event | openadr.Report | openadr.VEN | openadr.Resource |
		openadr.Subscription | openadr.ResourceGroup | openadr.Notification
}
```

Object is what Marshal and Unmarshal take.
